# Chip props

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `"primary" \| "destructive" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "secondary"` | `"secondary"` | Semantic color of the chip. |
| `variant` | `"contained" \| "outlined"` | `"contained"` | Fill style of the chip. |
| `onRemove` | `() => void` | — | Callback fired when the remove button is clicked; shows a remove button when provided. |
| `labels` | `Partial<ChipLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_CHIP_LABELS`. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `remove` | `string` | `"Remove"` | Name of the remove button, read with the chip's text. `{chip}` marks where the text goes: `"{chip} を削除"` reads "Apple を削除". Without `{chip}`, the text follows the label, so the default reads "Remove Apple". Only the first `{chip}` counts. |
